shortDescription: Prepare a walk, keep a private journal with photos, and bring your own GPX route.
longDescription:
Prepare a walk, keep a private journal with photos, and bring your own GPX route.

A private space for the places you’ve been and the moments worth keeping. Up to eight photos per walk. Copies stay private on this device; location metadata is removed.

Your personal pre-walk checklist. Adapt your kit to the route, weather and your needs.

Private GPX geometry stored on your device. Basemap tiles, elevation and reviewed directions are not included. Imported routes remain private and unreviewed. Check access and conditions before you walk.

Records while the screen is off or the app is minimised, with a persistent notification. Keep location enabled. Battery controls and device GPS availability can interrupt recording. Distance is an estimate; this is not a safety tracker. Only duration and estimated distance are stored privately on this device. Coordinates are used in memory and discarded. Nothing is uploaded.

Speech depends on compatible installed services. Voice commands currently support English only; touch controls are always available.

System speech services may process voice data under their own privacy terms. Uninstalling clears local data. Backups are disabled.

Purchasing is not available in this build. No products, prices or paid entitlements are configured. Your checklist, journal and one offline geometry pack are available free. GPX tools are included in this development release.
